articles.title: NFL Trade Rumors: Sam Darnold Seattle Seahawks linked to $5.25M former Steelers and Chargers running back

articles.title: Black Ops 7 and Call of Duty: Warzone Season 03 Content Drop: The Full Details
articles.summary: Upcoming Season 03 introduces a key gameplay change: 'Endgame Loadouts' will now be individually assigned to each 'Operator.' This ensures every character possesses a unique set of weapons, field acquisitions, and equipment, enhancing strategic depth. This shift moves from shared configurations to personalized kits, providing greater distinctiveness for individual operators in engagements.
